{{Quote|Eopies are swift-moving, herbivorous mammals that can cover long distances with minor moisture loss.|[[Lyrre T'enna]]'s notes on the Eoipe|<ref name=":0" />}}
'''Eopies''' were herbivores native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Characteristics==
The quadruped mammals were distinguished by their pale skin and long flexible snouts.<ref name="Episode I" /> An eopie's tough, pale, white skin<ref name=":1">{{DB|creature|eopie|eopie}}</ref> (which has sparse, smooth hair)<ref name=":0" /> helped keep the creature cool by reflecting the intense rays of the planet's twin [[Star/Legends|suns]].<ref name=":1" /> They were very social creatures that lived in large herds of 20 or more.<ref name=":0" />

[[File:Eopie.jpg|thumb|left|270px|A front and side view of an eopie mount.]]

A special hinged skull allowed for a very flexible, elongated snout and a broader range for sharp incisors. Eopies got most of their moisture from desert lichens and tubers.<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

Thick foot pads broaden on impact for maximum shock absorption when running. Elbow and knee calluses protect against the desert sands when they sit down - in a camellike way.<ref name=":0" />

When startled or angry, eopies spat undigested stomach contents at bothersome (such as pesky [[Sketto/Legends|skettos]]) or dangerous passersby - something considered extremely annoying to humanoids.<ref name=":0" />

Eopies reached maturity around six standard years of age and their average lifespan was 90 standard years; however like most creatures, the animal would weaken with age. Young eopies were much more vulnerable to the harsh desert conditions of the twin-sunned world. Young eopies needed to consume more food than a mature one and were also unable to carry as heavy a load. Newborn eopies were slow and awkward, but could walk within minutes of their birth,<ref name=":1" /> and were preyed upon by some of the more dangerous creatures of Tatooine, like [[Anooba/Legends|anooba]] and [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlaccs]].<ref name=":0" /> Older eopies were kept by the planet's [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] to eat desert weeds that absorbed the planet's already valuable moisture.<ref name=":1" /> They were also used as transports across the vast desert plains of the arid planet.<ref name="Episode I" />

[[File:NiktoEopie-FF.png|thumb|right|200px|A Nikto riding an eopie with blinders on]]
Eopies were renowned for their endurance and ability to carry a hefty amount of cargo.<ref name="Episode I" /> They also had a reputation of being stubborn or grumpy creatures.<ref name="SWE-eopie">{{SWE|characters|eopie|eopie}}</ref> This however, could be attributed to their owners, who often pushed these animals to the limit, packing them with extremely heavy loads.<ref name=":1" /> It could also be attributed to the limited diet available to these beasts of burden, which gave them incredibly potent flatulence.<ref name="Episode I">{{Film|I}}</ref> When domesticated eopies became too old to work, many Tatooine settler families gave them to their children as pets, as they became completely acclimated to handling.<ref name=":0" />

These creatures could also be used for consumption for their [[Milk/Legends|milk]] or their meat, in various dishes such as [[Eopie brisket]],<ref name="Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> [[Eopie stew/Legends|Eopie stew]]<ref name="MIA">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref> or [[Eopie Cream Pie|Eopie cream pie]].<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=general|Mission 4: Trone Thanamiroc|[[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]}}</ref>

Many breeds existed, including the '''dwarf eopie.'''<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref>

A population was apparently present on the planet [[Dra III]] where it was preyed upon by such creatures as the [[nashtah]].<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Several domesticated eopies were also present on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>

==History==
A couple of eopies were used by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] to transport a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] for [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]'s [[J-type 327 Nubian royal starship/Legends|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship]] after winning the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].<ref name="Episode I" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]] hired a spacer to kill [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland]] eopies in order to collect their livers to feed the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]] of the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="SWG:SR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shock Rods|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The development of the eopie began when a two-legged beast of burden concept was transplanted from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to become the [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]]. In the kaadu's place came the eopie design. An early [[Doug Chiang]] production painting of a kaadu hauling a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] engine was retouched in Photoshop so that the two-legged animal became a four-legged eopie.<ref name=":1" />
